name: Instant Gent
title: Instant Gent: a free 3D game of Ghent, by bike, on foot or on horseback
description: Cycle, walk or gallop through a 3D version of Ghent in your browser. Explore the city, race or play quests, alone or two players on one keyboard. Free, nothing to install.
share_title: Instant Gent: play through Ghent in 3D
share_description: Cycle, walk or gallop through Ghent in your browser. Explore, race or play quests, alone or with two. Free.
ld_description: A free 3D browser game set in Ghent, Belgium: explore the city, race or play quests by bike, on foot or on horseback, alone or two players split-screen.
noscript: Ride a bike, walk or gallop through a 3D Ghent in your browser. Turn on JavaScript to play.

en: Looking for a bike that hasn't been nicked yet
Opening the umbrella, it's bound to rain

This isn't Bruges, it takes a little while
Waiting for tram 1… another quarter of an hour
Laying the cobbles one by one
Putting the swans on the Leie
Poking the dragon on the Belfry awake
Loading Dulle Griet, just in case
Counting the Ghent Altarpiece… is a panel missing again?
Teaching the horses to stop at the zebra crossing
Shooing tourists off the cycle path
Sweeping up the last confetti of the Gentse Feesten
nl: Nen velo zoeken die nog nie gepikt es

't Es hier gien Brugge, 't duurt e bitje
Wachten op tram 1… nog e kwartierke
De kasseien één voor één leggen
De zwanen op de Leie zetten
De draak op 't Belfort wakker porren
Dulle Griet laden, voor de zekerheid
